think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and intended semantics in PostgreSQL. 2) Check whether the knob has documented sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch it into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/force). 3) Determine whether those sentinel values break the natural numeric ordering by changing the meaning rather than just scaling the same behavior. 4) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
